QUOTE: The whole file is compiled only when `MBEDTLS_ERROR_C` or `MBEDTLS_ERROR_STRERROR_DUMMY` is set. With `MBEDTLS_ERROR_C` off, the dummy `mbedtls_strerror` just writes an empty string.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the dummy switch and its empty-string behavior, but it never says the switch is enabled by default, so half of the item is missing.
